name: jev-browser
description: A small Playwright browser harness with Jev decisions

scripts.format: prettier --write src test README.md README.pt-BR.md docs package.json tsconfig.json .prettierrc.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src test README.md README.pt-BR.md docs package.json tsconfig.json .prettierrc.json
scripts.validate: npm run check && npm run format:check && npm test
